programmes.d: Cowboy Johnny Black vows to gun down Brett Clayton, the man responsible for the death of his father. He soon becomes a wanted outlaw while posing as a preacher in a small mining town that's been taken over by a notorious land baron.
Jeb Drummond is a murderous sheep herder who has Adam taken hostage to try and force Ben to sign over a large section of Ponderosa land to him.
A Ponderosa ranch hand faces charges of killing the wife of the U.S. marshal who came to arrest him.
As Ben prepares to run for governor, Joe must come to his rescue when a disabled police officer from New Orleans comes to arrest Ben on a 20-year-old murder charge.
After Sam Brewster's son gets shot in self-defense by Deputy Charlie, only Curly Bill Brocius decides to stand with the sheriff when they meet Brewster's men at the outskirts of town.
Clay receives what turns out to be a bogus telegram after killing a cattle baron who forced a gunfight; the people from the rancher's hometown plan to execute Clay for murder.
A smart-aleck boy from Brooklyn comes west to seek his fortune.
A U.S. marshal arrives in North Fork, taking an Indian prisoner back east for trial.
A woman whom Lucas remembers as a card cheat opens a boardinghouse in town.
Lucas risks his life when he offers to appear as a witness in a murder trial.

Bat tries to help Clyde Richards negotiate the purchase of an old mining road to create a route through the mountains, but when Bat recognizes the holdout owner from his past, the mission takes a dark turn.
At Crazy Creek Station, an Indian and his gang take Bat, Major Mars and Lottie Tremaine hostage to exact revenge upon Mars for a number of crimes he committed against Indians.
Blowing a hole in a levee up-river becomes the only way to save New Orleans from a record flood.
After winning a half-share of a Virginia City silver mine, Yancy discovers a neighboring mine stealing from it.
Rube Burrows becomes infamous through the south for train robbery, but his girlfriend is portrayed as the brains; Margaret ingratiates herself with the outlaws leading to a deadly showdown.
A former deputy and his gang terrorize a town with the help of a corrupt sheriff.
A sheriff fears that his prisoner will escape on his trip to Tucson.
Josh has doubts about an alleged murderer.
Old West drifters Jake (Kevin Costner), Emmett (Scott Glenn), Mal and Paden (Kevin Kline) shoot it out with a crooked sheriff and clan.
A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.
A town marshal (Jock Mahoney) owes his life to an aging gunfighter (Dale Robertson) and refuses to stop him until the debt is paid.

Ranchers are angry and suspicious when proceeds of a sale made by Hoppy wind up in the hands of a snake oil salesman.
Hoppy sets out to catch a chronic breaker of saloon windows.
Marshal Matt Wayne looks for the men who killed his business partner.
Outlaws murder Father Holzer when he takes in a youngster.
